scheme_name: Free Bus Pass for Media Persons
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or have continuous residence for at least five years
Applicant must have served a minimum of three years as a media person in Print/Electronic Media/News Agency in Puducherry
Applicant must be employed as a media person in any Print/Electronic Media/News Agency at the time of application
The term "Media person" includes full‑time Editor, News Editor, Sub Editor, Reporter, Press Photographer, Videographer, or Correspondent of Print/Electronic Media/News Agency within Puducherry
benefits_summary: Free bus pass valid for one year for professional travel needs
